headline: Far fewer United flights are in the air than usual right now.

items.text: The 174 United flights in the air are 73% fewer than usual for this time of day; over the past 7 days the median at this hour was 651.

The FAA has a ground delay program for flights into San Francisco until 11:59 PM PT because of wind; those flights are held at their departure airport, with delays averaging 138 minutes and up to 690 minutes. San Francisco also has 3 confirmed cancellations among its 323 departures today.
Los Angeles is the lowest of the seven United hubs reporting so far today, with 73% of departures within 30 minutes of schedule (52 departed).

Newark has somewhat low clouds or visibility and rain, which can cause minor delays. Elsewhere, the FAA has a ground stop for flights into Toronto (YYZ) until 6:15 PM ET, and ground delay programs for flights into Boston (BOS) until 9:59 PM ET, New York LaGuardia (LGA) until 10:59 PM ET and San Diego (SAN).

traveler_note.text: If you are flying to San Francisco, check your flight status before leaving for the airport, and do the same for Toronto, Boston, New York LaGuardia or San Diego.
